outcome: Incidence of pregnancy-related acute kidney injury (Pr-AKI)
finding: Pr-AKI occurred in 2.09% of pregnant women, with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy being the leading cause, and was associated with severe fetal morbidities and mortalities, especially in women with uncontrolled blood pressure, high altitude, and advanced AKI.
mod_finding: Patients with HDP-related Pr-AKI had a higher cesarean rate.
